auth_account_delete_cleanup_explanation: Authentication ends immediately when deletion is accepted. The items below are the cleanup scope; native, shared and external cleanup can remain pending. A deleted account cannot be restored.
auth_account_delete_cleanup_pending: Authentication has ended. Cleanup of native, shared and external copies is still pending; this is not confirmation of complete erasure.
auth_account_delete_confirmation_error: Type the confirmation phrase shown above.
auth_account_delete_denied: This account cannot be deleted yet. Complete the items listed above first.
auth_account_delete_description: This permanently deletes your REZICS account, signs you out everywhere, and cannot be undone.
auth_account_delete_erased_collections: Your private, unlisted and deleted Collections.
auth_account_delete_erased_library: Your whole library: shelf entries, reading progress and history, copies and follows.
auth_account_delete_erased_profile: Your profile, name, handle and avatar.
auth_account_delete_finality: Deletion is final and cannot be undone.
auth_account_delete_no_automated_account: No automated accounts are operated by this account.
auth_account_delete_not_last_owner: You are not the last owner of any organization.
auth_account_delete_prepare: If you do not want something to stay, make the Collection private or delete the post first.
auth_account_delete_privacy_contact: To get a copy of your data, before or after deletion, contact {contact}.
auth_account_delete_retained_attribution: These contributions remain attributed to “Deleted account”, frozen and no longer editable by anyone. No replacement curator is assigned.
auth_account_delete_retained_collections: Your public Collections as they are now, with their current notes.
auth_account_delete_security_description: This permanently deletes your REZICS account and signs you out everywhere.
auth_account_delete_unavailable: Account deletion is unavailable right now.
auth_account_operation_failure: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
auth_account_operation_reconfirm: Your identity was verified. Review the request and confirm again. No action has been executed by returning here.
auth_account_operation_sign_in_required: You are signed out. Sign in to manage your account.
auth_account_operation_unavailable: A required service is unavailable. No success is confirmed. Retry later.
auth_account_operation_unknown: The result is unknown. The operation may have taken effect. Retry the same request; do not start a duplicate. If signed out, that alone does not confirm deletion.
auth_consent_approved: Access approved. You can return to the client.
auth_consent_declined: The client got no new access.
auth_consent_scope_offline_access: Keep access when you are away
auth_consent_sign_in_required: Sign in to review this request.
auth_failure_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
auth_failure_retry_after: Too many requests. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_failure_unavailable: Sign-in and recovery are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth_inventory_clients_description: These applications are your responsibility. Their registered permissions do not grant you access.
auth_inventory_clients_empty: You do not own any applications.
auth_inventory_consents_description: These grants let applications act for you. A grant does not mean you own the application.
auth_inventory_consents_empty: You have not granted any application permissions.
auth_inventory_denied: Access was refused. No change is confirmed.
auth_inventory_expired: This page has expired or your session changed. Reload the list.
auth_inventory_preflight: This list does not confirm deletion eligibility. Resolve application ownership and other responsibilities first; deletion checks them again.
auth_inventory_reduced: Access was reduced and your sessions were invalidated. Sign in again to see current permissions.
auth_inventory_remove_confirm: Remove access for {name}? This also signs you out of your sessions.
auth_inventory_unavailable: This list is unavailable. Your responsibilities and permissions are unknown.
auth_inventory_unknown: The result is unknown. Sign in again and reload before making another change.
auth_login_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth_login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
auth_login_recovery_success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth_login_retry_after: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_login_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth_organization_conflict: The organization could not be created. The handle may be taken.
auth_organization_delete_accepted: The organization deletion command was accepted. Cleanup across all data owners, shared copies and external copies may still be pending; complete erasure is not confirmed.
auth_organization_delete_changed: The account, organization or request changed. Review the current organization and confirm a new request.
auth_organization_delete_denied: The native deletion checks refused this request. Resolve ownership obligations, pending transfers and operated accounts before confirming again.
auth_organization_delete_effect: Deletion permanently closes this organization and cannot be undone. Native, shared and external cleanup can remain pending.
auth_organization_delete_read_denied: This organization is missing or you cannot currently manage it. No private summary or deletion is available.
auth_organization_delete_remedies: Resolve the organization’s ownership obligations, pending transfers and operated accounts first. Current native authority and responsibility checks decide whether deletion is allowed.
auth_organization_delete_still_readable: The organization is currently readable. The earlier command result remains unknown. Do not start another deletion.
auth_organization_delete_unknown: The deletion result is unknown and may have taken effect. Check the current organization; do not start another deletion. A missing organization or lost access alone does not confirm deletion.
auth_organization_explanation: An organization has no sign-in of its own. Creation requires your current permission and an open platform gate; you may be asked to verify your identity.
auth_organization_handle_invalid: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_organization_not_open: This part of REZICS is not open yet.
auth_organization_refused: Creation was refused. Check your permission to create an organization and whether the handle is available.
auth_passkey_denied: That passkey was not accepted. Try again or use your password.
auth_recovery_link_invalid: This recovery link is invalid or has expired.
auth_recovery_password_invalid: Password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
auth_recovery_start_success: If an account uses this address, we sent a link.
auth_rename_confirm: I confirm changing this account’s handle to @{handle}.
auth_rename_conflict: The current handle changed, the requested handle is unavailable, or native approval refused the change. The current account has been reloaded. Review it and confirm again.
auth_rename_denied: Your current session cannot rename this account. No permission has been assumed.
auth_rename_description: Choose a new handle for your current account. Your account and its content keep the same identity.
auth_rename_forwarding: Your former handle forwards to this same account for 30 days. After that it stays reserved to your account and cannot be assigned to anyone else.
auth_rename_invalid: Enter a different handle using 3–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, with a letter or number at each end. Spaces are not allowed.
auth_rename_reconfirm: Review this saved change and explicitly confirm again. Returning from identity confirmation does not submit a rename.
auth_rename_signed_out: Sign in to rename your own account.
auth_rename_unavailable: Account renaming is unavailable. We could not read or confirm your current account securely. Reload before trying again.
auth_rename_unknown: The rename outcome is not confirmed. Keep this change unchanged and retry to check the current handle using the same operation.
auth_security_action_unknown: The action result is unknown. Check current security settings before trying again.
auth_security_action_accepted: Auth accepted the action. This response does not verify the later security inventory.
auth_security_action_unverified: Your session is no longer authorized. The action result has not been verified. Sign in to check current security settings.
auth_security_authority_changed: Your account or security authority changed. Sign in again to load current security settings.
auth_security_readback_unavailable: Current security settings could not be verified. The action result remains unresolved. Try checking again.
auth_security_target_absent: The selected item is absent from the current security inventory.
auth_security_target_present: The selected item is still in the current security inventory. You can check again or confirm another attempt.
auth_security_passkey_add_failed: The passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth_security_passkey_last_credential: You cannot remove your last way to sign in. Add a password or another passkey first.
auth_security_passkey_remove_confirmatio: Remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
auth_security_passkey_remove_failed: The passkey could not be removed. Please try again later.
auth_security_passkeys_description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or a security key instead of a password.
auth_security_passkeys_empty: You have not added a passkey yet.
auth_security_passkeys_failed: Your passkeys could not be loaded. Please try again later.
auth_security_password_failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again later.
auth_security_password_invalid: Password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
auth_security_sessions_failed: Your sessions could not be loaded. Please try again later.
auth_security_sign_in_required: You are signed out. Sign in to manage your security settings.
auth_signup_conflict: We could not create this account. Sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_denied: Check the handle, email, password and verification, then try again.
auth_signup_handle_invalid: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_signup_handle_unavailable: That handle is taken or reserved.
auth_signup_password_invalid: Password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
auth_signup_turnstile_required: Complete the security check before creating your account.
auth_step_up_explanation: Your session is not recent enough for this request, so enter your email and password to continue.
auth_members_intro: Manage existing organization membership using your own current authority.
auth_members_denied: Current authority does not permit this request. No permission is inferred from this page.
auth_members_preparing: Membership is preparing. Reload the current list before continuing.
auth_members_conflict: Membership changed or the command conflicts with native responsibility rules. Reload before continuing.
auth_members_unknown: The outcome is unknown. Keep this exact command for retry; the current list alone does not establish its outcome.
auth_members_acknowledged: The command was acknowledged. The list below is a separate current native read; acknowledgement does not establish final workflow completion.
auth_members_step_up: Sign in again as the original person, then review and submit the same change again.
auth_members_unavailable: Membership management is unavailable. No change is confirmed.
auth_members_no_reservation: The native source does not provide this membership’s reservation. Role changes and removal are unavailable.
auth_members_empty_page: No current holders were returned on this page.
auth_members_authority: Native current membership, owner, surviving organization and responsibility rules decide whether the change is allowed. Resource grants are separate.
auth_members_confirm_check: I confirm this exact organization, member and effect.
